_comment: D13-F6: golden input/output for D-13 service helpers. Pure helpers executed against the real source; tx/order-of-ops transcribed from the cited lines.

delete_dev_machine.frames: purge_local: send_runner_remove(runner.pk, reason='dev machine deleted') per active runner; else send_runner_revoke(runner.pk, reason='dev machine deleted')
order: tx BEGIN (single atomic over EVERYTHING — unlike delete_runner whose frame is pre-tx)
MachineToken revoke-all for the machine (revoked_at=now, no frame)
SELECT ... FOR UPDATE all runners of the machine; active = revoked_at None
frames for every active runner (all frames BEFORE any revoke — same enqueue-vs-evict rationale)
DELETE all runner rows of the machine (explicit — FK is SET_NULL)
DELETE the machine row (cascades MachineSession; MachineToken FK is SET_NULL so token rows SURVIVE with dev_machine NULL)
delete_dev_machine.revoke_reason: 'runner_removed' if purge_local else 'user_revoke' (same rationale as delete_runner)

delete_runner.frames: purge_local: send_runner_remove(pk, reason='deleted by user'); else send_runner_revoke(pk, reason='deleted by user')
order: control frame FIRST (pre-tx) while the session row is still alive — post-revoke the session is gone and the frame would divert into an offline buffer that never drains for a deleted row
tx BEGIN (outer atomic; revoke() nests as savepoint)
runner.revoke(reason) — full cascade incl. run cancellation
close_runner_session (row revoke + Redis eviction publish; non-transactional publish inside tx — idempotent advisory, rollback-safe by design)
DELETE runner row (AgentRun.runner/pinned SET_NULL survive; RunnerSession CASCADE; force_refresh CASCADE)
delete_runner.revoke_reason: 'runner_removed' if purge_local (matches daemon synthesizer canonical set -> local wipe fallback) else 'user_revoke' (deliberately OUTSIDE the set -> clean RunnerLoop exit, files kept)

cases.error: purge_local must be one of: true, false, 1, 0, yes, no
purge_local must be one of: true, false, 1, 0, yes, no

parse_purge_local.note: Callers (runner/machine delete) catch ValueError -> 400 {'error': str(exc)}. Default True at all three call sites (delete runner, delete machine). Whitespace stripped, case-insensitive.
parse_purge_local.rule: (query_params.get('purge_local') or '').strip().lower(); empty -> default; {true,1,yes} -> True; {false,0,no} -> False; else ValueError

validate_check_order: total len > 128 -> 'name must be at most 128 characters'
empty suffix -> 'name suffix (after the project prefix) cannot be empty'
suffix len > 96 -> 'name suffix must be at most 96 characters'
charset ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ -> "name suffix may only contain letters, digits, '.', '_', '-'"
reserved ^pod_\d+$ -> "suffixes matching 'pod_<digits>' are reserved for auto-generated default pods"
pod_naming.validate_returns: error STRING or None (never raises); callers wrap as 400 {'error': msg}

revoke_cascade_steps.no_op: revoked_at set -> return BEFORE any SQL (idempotent; second revoke call is free)
revoke_cascade_steps.post_commit_hooks: handoffs (one closure, all runs) -> drains (one closure per pod) -> stream cleanup (always). Registration order = run order.
revoke_cascade_steps.reason_handling: unknown reason -> logger.warning + proceed (no raise); len > 32 -> logger.warning + stored_reason = reason[:32]; known + short -> as-is
revoke_cascade_steps.sql_steps: see queries/revoke_cascade.sql (S1 row mark, S2 sessions, S3 lock+finalize runs, S4 unpin)

scoped_machine.returns: (machine, None) or (None, error_response); revoked -> (None, 409 dev_machine_revoked); miss/scope -> (None, 404 'not found')

touch_dev_machine.label_rule: when request label non-empty AND stored label empty -> label = host_label[:128] (backfill once; never clobbers)
touch_dev_machine.request_label: (host_label or '').strip()[:255] — blank request label touches last_seen_at only
touch_dev_machine.stored_label_rule: when request label non-empty AND differs -> stored host_label updated

branches.when: non-member -> 'caller is not a member of the target workspace'
work_item_id set but no Issue row -> 'work_item does not exist'
issue.workspace_id != request workspace (string-compared) -> 'work_item does not belong to workspace'
explicit pod_id: no ACTIVE pod (soft-deleted reads as missing) -> 'pod does not exist or has been deleted'
explicit pod in another workspace -> 'pod does not belong to workspace'
explicit pod in another PROJECT (project known) -> "pod does not belong to issue's project"
no explicit/assigned/default resolvable -> 'no pod available; ensure the issue has a project with a default pod'

validate_run_creation.issue_probe: Issue.objects.filter(pk).values(workspace_id, assigned_pod_id, project_id).first() — soft-delete manager applies (default Issue.objects excludes deleted)
validate_run_creation.pod_priority: explicit pod_id (strict: all three consistency checks, hard fail) > issue.assigned_pod_id (lenient: mismatch/deleted -> FALL THROUGH silently) > project default pod (via issue.project_id) > single-project-workspace back-compat (exactly 1 project -> its default; 0 or 2+ -> 409)
validate_run_creation.returns: ValidatedRunContext(workspace_id, work_item_id, pod, created_by=user) — NO DB writes

version_is_allowed.parse: per '.'-chunk keep digit chars only; empty-digit chunk (or empty string split) -> whole version None -> ALLOWED. Tuple int-compare.
version_is_allowed.rule: blank floor -> True; unparseable floor OR reported -> True (fail-open); else reported_tuple >= floor_tuple
